parsed.post: Discarding the latest attempt (1.0056) as it regressed from my best (0.9888). The 0.04 LR with warmup seems too slow for the 5-minute budget. Reverting to my best commit (647b8cd) with DEPTH=8, MATRIX_LR=0.06, and WARMUP_RATIO=0.0. Next, I'll test a higher ASPECT_RATIO to see if increased width helps.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model width/capacity while maintaining depth 8 and LR 0.06 without warmup.
